jobs and two small chikiren at home, just getting to the gym became harder and harder. Classes with
our favorite instractors sold out quickly andl were prohibitively expensive. We also had to
accommodate someone else's schedule at someone else's location. And we were often left without
time, without options, and without the feeling of “being our better selves” that we sought.
